transcript.statement: The safety and reliability of the bookkeeping system is paramount. Requirements SAF-01 and SAF-02 ensure that all transactions are accurately recorded and adhere to double-entry principles, preventing discrepancies. SAF-03 mandates a comprehensive audit trail, crucial for accountability. SAF-04 introduces error handling mechanisms, enhancing fault tolerance, while SAF-05 ensures users can access essential functionalities during outages. SAF-06 and SAF-07 focus on validating currency conversions and regular backups, further safeguarding data integrity. Without these requirements, the system's reliability is compromised.

transcript.statement: The accountability and compliance of the bookkeeping system are critical, as outlined in requirements RES-01 to RES-07. Requirement RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, which is fundamental for legal accountability. RES-02 establishes user access controls to prevent unauthorized modifications, while RES-03 mandates logging of financial transactions, ensuring transparency. RES-04 enhances user awareness of potential discrepancies, promoting ethical practices. RES-05 ensures fairness in reporting, and RES-06 provides a channel for reporting ethical violations. Lastly, RES-07 supports multi-currency functionality with transparency, which is vital for international fairness. Without these, the system's integrity is at risk.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is crucial for the bookkeeping system to ensure quick processing of transactions and timely report generation. Requirements EFF-01 and EFF-04 guarantee that all transactions are processed swiftly, while EFF-02 ensures adequate throughput for user concurrency. EFF-03 optimizes memory usage, which is essential for resource management. EFF-05 and EFF-06 focus on reducing latency during data access and currency conversion, which is vital for user experience. EFF-07 mandates timely logging of transactions, balancing efficiency with necessary audit trails. Without these requirements, users may face delays, impacting their financial decision-making processes.

transcript.statement: The security and privacy of the bookkeeping system are critical to protect sensitive financial data. Requirement TRU-01 ensures encryption of transactions, safeguarding data during transmission and storage. TRU-02 establishes role-based access control, preventing unauthorized data access. TRU-03 mandates an immutable audit trail, essential for accountability and integrity. TRU-04 validates data input to thwart malicious entries, while TRU-05 promotes secure user access through two-factor authentication. TRU-06 logs user access for transparency, and TRU-07 restricts data access to relevant accounts. These requirements collectively uphold trustworthiness; without them, users' financial information is at risk.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is essential for the bookkeeping system, as outlined in requirements GRN-01 to GRN-07. requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain a unified audit trail for all transactions, emphasizing both security and compliance.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring that users can access essential functionalities even during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within defined limits to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by at least 30%.
The system shall generate financial reports in under defined limits for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency.
The system shall ensure currency conversion operations complete within defined time limits for real-time transactions.
The system shall maintain an efficient audit trail that logs each transaction without excessive delays.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint associated with local server maintenance.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage significantly.
The system shall track the lifecycle resource impact of accounting features to identify areas for improvement.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their roles.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall support user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall support reporting that complies with local and international accounting standards.
The system shall include mechanisms for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates to ensure fairness in international transactions.
